seoTitle: Image to Text Converter for English OCR
metaDescription: Extract editable English text from a JPG, PNG or WebP image in your browser.
intro: Extract editable English text from a JPG, PNG or WebP image in your browser.
aboutTitle: What makes OCR text more accurate?
about: A sharp image with clear, upright text and good contrast is easier to recognize. Proofread names, numbers and punctuation before reusing the result.
example: Upload a screenshot of an English heading and paragraph, extract the text and compare it with the image before copying or downloading.

faqs.question: Why is the first OCR run slower?
faqs.answer: The browser downloads the English recognition model on first use. The selected image is processed on your device.
